summary: Lowered PHASE3_PER_SYMBOL_MIN_TRADES from 15 to 8 and PHASE3_PER_SYMBOL_MIN_RETURN from 1.5 to 0.5 in gpu_fuzzy_trader/config.py to allow more symbols to pass per-symbol greedy selection. Added PHASE3_DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT_ENABLED=True flag. In Rule_Set_Selector.run(), added per-symbol diagnostic accumulation that writes outputs/reports/gen_diag_iter12.csv with columns: direction, symbol, val_trades, val_return_pct, train_val_gap_pct, n_rules_selected, top_rule_condition_signature. Added comprehensive unit test in tests/unit/test_phase3_threshold_diagnostic.py that verifies config values, threshold filtering logic (monkeypatched scoring confirms 8-trade/0.5%-return rules pass while 7-trade or 0.4%-return rules are rejected), and integration-level diagnostic CSV writing with correct columns.
notes_for_reviewer: The threshold filtering test uses monkeypatched _score_pool_rule_on_symbol to verify that 8-trades/0.5%-return rules are admitted and 7-trades or 0.4%-return rules are rejected. This is necessary because the real engine simulation in _per_symbol_greedy's _robust_combo_return uses the actual CPUBacktestEngine which makes exact trade/return control impractical.

The diagnostic CSV uses append mode ('a') when the file already exists, so both long and short direction runs accumulate rows into the same gen_diag_iter12.csv file. This matches the expected format with both directions' data.
Legacy tp/sl/capital_pct fields at the top level of each rule in the output JSON are preserved (no changes to _build_output_dict).
The CONDITION_SIGNATURE uses ';'.join of all conditions of the top selected pool rule for each symbol. This is a simple string fingerprint for human readability.
No changes to evaluator_v5.ipynb or friend_project/.
Full pipeline re-run not performed in this step (orchestrator will trigger after merge).
